UDP is a connectionless protocol..why: Stated in the first lines of Wikipedia's User Datagram Protocol article.

sources.quote: UDP is a connectionless protocol, meaning that messages are sent without negotiating a connection and that UDP does not keep track of what it has sent.

The Internet Protocol (IP) is a connecti.why: Stated in Wikipedia's Internet Protocol article (it provides connectionless datagram service).

sources.quote: In network architectural parlance, it is a connectionless protocol, in contrast to connection-oriented communication.

TCP is a connection-oriented protocol..why: Stated in the first lines of Wikipedia's Transmission Control Protocol article.

sources.quote: TCP is connection-oriented, meaning that sender and receiver first need to establish a connection based on agreed parameters; they do this through a three-way handshake procedure.

HTTP is a programming language..why: Deliberately false so that the disjunction depends on the inserted fact: HTTP is a protocol.
